claims.claim: Main codec compatible is `qcom,wcd9378-codec`.
Reset wiring is modeled with `qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node` phandle.
Codec references SoundWire child nodes via `qcom,rx-slave` and `qcom,tx-slave`.
SoundWire port/ch mapping is provided through `qcom,rx_swr_ch_map` and `qcom,tx_swr_ch_map`.
`qcom,swr-tx-port-params` DT property is required for functional TX setup.
Micbias values are expected as `qcom,cdc-micbias*-mv` properties.
Upstream `qcom,wcd937x*.yaml` can be used as-is with no binding adjustments.
WCD9378 downstream path depends on Qualcomm SWR stack (`<soc/soundwire.h>`) rather than upstream Linux SDW APIs.
RX/TX slave paging must be enabled (`paging_support = true`).
Legacy SWR APIs (`swr_driver_register`, `swr_get_logical_dev_num`) are required for probe/bind flow.
Upstream SoundWire core changes are required before WCD9378 can be upstreamed.
WCD9378 bring-up requires source changes in LPASS RX/TX macro drivers.
No direct WCD9378-specific coupling exists inside upstream LPASS RX/TX macro source files.
WCD9378 codec path requires Class-H control and routing.
Upstream `wcd-clsh-v2` must gain a dedicated WCD9378 codec version enum.
Downstream Class-H API usage must be mapped from legacy `wcd_cls_h_*` to upstream v2 control interface.
Downstream SDW slave identity is `qcom,wcd9378-slave` / `wcd9378-slave`.
Upstream-compatible SDW identity should align to `sdw20217010a00` style binding.
Slave debugfs peek/poke/register-dump hooks are required for upstream functionality.
SDW implementation should follow upstream pattern with `devm_regmap_init_sdw` and Linux SDW component flow.
Current codec file includes vendor-only dependencies that are not upstreamable.
Regulator handling must move from `msm_cdc_*` helpers to upstream regulator APIs.
Reset handling must move from vendor pinctrl/reset-node handling to upstream GPIO reset model.
MBHC behavior should be represented via shared `wcd-mbhc-v2` model with codec-specific callbacks only.
WCD9378 register and DAPM surface area is large and requires explicit triage before conversion.
QTI regmap/debugfs and SDCA debugfs helpers are needed only for bring-up debug, not upstream driver function.
Temporary bring-up prints/debug paths should be excluded from upstream patching scope.
External bring-up playback is confirmed working.
External bring-up capture is confirmed working.
Any mute-path runtime issue is fully resolved.
Provided amixer recipe(s) are sufficient to prove generic upstream readiness.
amixer recipe(s) are board-specific smoke checks and not a full upstream validation substitute.
